text_block_list.text:
"The Stayers Stakes. A 3,600m graded race 
that is even longer than the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)."

Depending on how you look at it, this 
might be an even tougher race than the 
Kikuka Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The longer it is, the more time we have to 
enjoy ourselves, right, Trainer?

Yet Mejiro Bright showed no signs of 
feeling pressured. In fact, she seemed 
rather delighted...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I do. I certainly do, but... I 
have dreamt of this for so, so long."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've dreamed that someday, I too might run 
in such a lo~ng race like the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... so this is... the Tenno Sho 
shield...

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's so lovely~. Even if... even if I 
cannot be of help right now, someday...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was merely preparing myself mentally. 
Even someone like me, from whom no Mejiro 
expected anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've always, always wanted to be of help 
someday...

—Mental preparation. Perhaps that was why 
she was able to adapt to long distances in 
the Kikuka Sho.

If she can run well in this Stayers Stakes 
too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, to be honest, I'm feeling a 
little lonely too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Part of me also wanted to see Bright 
competing on the same medium-distance 
route as me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"You really did dote on Bright, didn't 
you? Truly."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we must not let our personal 
feelings decide that child's path."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This race will make it clear. Whether she 
should prioritize long-distance or 
medium-distance in the Senior Class—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps—it was neither.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: "I will be watching as well. —Right here."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother...!! Why did you come all this 
way yourself!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even though today is just a GII race...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
There are some races that one simply must 
watch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes—to understand the future of the Mejiro 
family.
